scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Homogeneous depth-five lower bounds for iterated matrix multiplication” (preprints/Homogeneous-depth-five-lower-bounds-for-iterated-matrix-multiplication-September-25-2026/Homogeneous-depth-five-lower-bounds-for-iterated-matrix-multiplication-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 135 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c8b7c21cad425efe), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist absolute constants c > 0 and n0 such that, for every integer n ≥ n0, every syntactically homogeneous ΣΠΣΠΣ circuit over C computing IMMn,n has size at least nc √ n . One may take c = 1/400.
